newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson says consent solicitation supported.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson says consent solicitation supported.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson and Co said Monday that its estimates show that more than 80 percent of the "voted" Great Western Financial Corp common shares support Ahmanson's consent solicitation.
Ahmanson also said that "it appears that 19 of Great Western's 20 largest stockholders have voted for or indicated a vote for Ahmanson's consent proposal.

Great Western agreed in early March to merge with Washington Mutual Savings Bank to thwart Ahmanson's hostile bid. Great Western last week formally rejected Ahmanson's latest bid and urged shareholders against signing Ahmanson's consent solicitation.

"The Great Western Board has failed to create a level playing field for bidders, which is not in the best interests of Great Western stockholders. Therefore it is imperative that Great Western stockholders who have yet to mail their consent proposals vote for Ahmanson's consent propposals in order to send a clear mesage that the Gerat Western Board sholuld enter into discussions with Ahmanson to assure that the stockholders' investment in Great Western is maximized," the company said in a statement.
Great Western was not immediately available for comment.
